interpretation: tourney_date is an approximate tournament-week date; winner_rank_points/loser_rank_points are rankings at that date, never event awards. A includes both ATP250/500 and Laver Cup; M Masters, F Finals; exclude G and D, and explicit team event. No automatic ID match for M-prefixed local IDs. Qualifying CSV larger than connector limit, bytes not acquired.

crosscheck.notes: Local M-prefixed IDs are candidate mappings based on event name/category and calendar context, not ATP IDs; 50 direct numeric associations also not proof of licence identity. The 61 knockout events' result row counts equal advertised entrants minus 1; this is only a count cross-check, not complete draw proof. Both Finals have 12 RR+2 SF+1 F. Do not use tourney_date as actual phase start.
